load_failed: Billing couldn't be loaded. Please try again in a moment.
status_desc: The Hontrio fee is paid monthly, for each store, only on the sales brought by Hontrio campaigns.
status_launch: Hontrio is free during the launch period. Billing starts only after we tell you, by email and here, at least 30 days in advance, and sales until then are not counted.
status_scheduled: Billing starts on {{date}}. Sales until then are not counted. If you don't want to pay, you can close your account before that, at no cost.
status_active: Billing started on {{date}}. The invoice for a month arrives on the 15th of the next month, with 10 days to pay.
grid_ron: Stores selling in lei: up to 5,000 lei a month, free; from 5,000 to 10,000 lei, 199 lei; above 10,000 lei, 2% of sales.
grid_eur: Stores selling in euros: up to €1,000 a month, free; from €1,000 to €2,000, €39; above €2,000, 2% of sales.
how_counted: We count orders that came from Hontrio campaigns and were paid or delivered, at the value of the products without shipping and without VAT.
terms_link: The full rules are in the Terms, section 9.
month_desc: What this month would cost so far, for each store. The final amount is set after the month ends.
month_no_store_desc: Once you connect a store, this shows what Hontrio campaigns bring in this month.
orders_none: No orders brought by Hontrio in this period.
details_desc: They appear on the Hontrio invoice, issued through SmartBill, and in e-Factura. For a Romanian company you only enter the CUI, and we fetch the rest from ANAF.
anaf_filled: We filled in the company details from ANAF. Check them and save.
anaf_not_found: ANAF has no company with this CUI.
anaf_unavailable: ANAF isn't answering right now. Enter the details by hand or try again later.
f_email_hint: We send the invoice and the payment link here.
f_city_hint: For Bucharest, enter the sector, for example “Sector 3”.
f_vat_payer: The company is registered for VAT
details_footer: Hontrio doesn't add VAT, because VOID SFT GAMES SRL is not registered for VAT.
save_failed: The details couldn't be saved. Please try again.
err_cui: The CUI isn't valid. Check the digits.
err_vat: The VAT number doesn't look right.
err_sector: For Bucharest, the city is the sector, for example “Sector 3”.
err_email: The invoice email address isn't valid.
invoices_desc: Each closed month, per store, with the counted orders, the fee and the invoice. If an order shouldn't be counted, you can dispute it.
invoices_empty_active: The first invoice appears on the 15th of the month, for the previous month.
invoices_empty_launch: No invoices are issued during the launch period.
statement_sales_one: {{count}} order counted, sales of {{sales}}, fee from the grid {{fee}}.
statement_sales_other: {{count}} orders counted, sales of {{sales}}, fee from the grid {{fee}}.
statement_credit: Credit for orders refunded after an earlier invoice: {{amount}}.
dispute_desc: Tell us why this order shouldn't be counted. We'll check it and, if it doesn't meet the rules, remove it from the calculation.
dispute_placeholder: For example: the customer returned the product.
dispute_sent: We received your dispute. We'll reply in Support.
dispute_failed: The dispute couldn't be sent. Please try again.
suspended_title: The autopilot is paused because of an unpaid invoice
suspended_body: For {{stores}}, the autopilot won't run until payment, and neither will the safety stop. The campaigns keep running in Google Ads. After payment, the autopilot starts again within a day.
pilot_suspended: The autopilot is paused because of an unpaid Hontrio invoice. It starts again after payment.
launch_suspended: You can't launch new campaigns while a Hontrio invoice is unpaid.
error_unknown_result: SmartBill didn't answer when issuing. Check in SmartBill whether the invoice exists.
invoice_mentions_one: Fee calculated from {{count}} order brought by Hontrio campaigns in {{month}}, with sales of {{sales}} (Terms, section 9).
invoice_mentions_other: Fee calculated from {{count}} orders brought by Hontrio campaigns in {{month}}, with sales of {{sales}} (Terms, section 9).
invoice_credit: A credit of {{amount}} was deducted from the fee, for orders refunded after an earlier invoice.
notif_profile_body: The Hontrio invoice for {{store}} is waiting for your company details. We'll issue it as soon as you add them in Settings, under Billing.
notif_invoice_body: For {{store}}, {{amount}} to pay. The invoice and card payment are in Settings, under Billing.
notif_paid_body: Thank you, we received your payment.
notif_paid_resumed: Thank you, we received your payment, and the autopilot is running again.
notif_final_body: If the invoice isn't paid within 7 days, the autopilot pauses for {{store}}.
notif_suspended_body: Invoice {{number}} isn't paid. Until payment, the campaigns keep running in Google Ads, without the autopilot and without the safety stop.
notif_notice_body: From {{date}}, sales brought by Hontrio campaigns count towards the monthly fee. The details are in Settings, under Billing.
email_footer: You're receiving this email because you have a Hontrio account. Billing emails are sent even when notifications are turned off.
email_notice_body: Until now Hontrio has been free, during the launch period. From {{date}}, sales brought by Hontrio campaigns count towards the monthly fee, and the first invoice arrives on the 15th of the following month. Sales until then are not counted.
email_notice_grid: The fee depends only on the sales Hontrio brings in a month. In lei: up to 5,000 lei, free; up to 10,000 lei, 199 lei; above that, 2% of sales. In euros: up to €1,000, free; up to €2,000, €39; above that, 2%.
email_notice_exit: If you don't want to pay, you can close your account before that date, at no cost. So we can issue the invoice, add your company details in Settings, under Billing.
email_invoice_body: We issued invoice {{number}} for the sales Hontrio campaigns brought to {{store}} in {{month}}. It's due on {{due}}.
email_invoice_pay_card: You can pay it by card, with the button below, or by bank transfer, to the account on the invoice.
email_invoice_pay_transfer: You can pay it by bank transfer, to the account on the invoice.
email_due_body: Invoice {{number}}, for {{amount}}, was due on {{due}} and doesn't show as paid yet.
email_due_ignore: If you've already paid, there's nothing to do, the payment shows up on our side within a day.
email_final_body: Invoice {{number}}, for {{amount}}, isn't paid. If it isn't paid by {{date}}, the Hontrio autopilot pauses for {{store}}.
email_final_campaigns: While the autopilot is paused, the campaigns keep running in Google Ads, without the safety stop. You can pause them at any time directly in Google Ads.
email_suspended_body: Invoice {{number}} isn't paid, so the autopilot no longer runs for {{store}}. It starts again within a day after payment.
email_suspended_campaigns: Hontrio campaigns keep running in Google Ads, without the autopilot and without the safety stop. If you want to pause them, you can do it directly in Google Ads.
email_paid_body: We received the payment for invoice {{number}}. Thank you!
email_paid_resumed: The autopilot is running again and resumes its daily pass tomorrow.
email_profile_subject: Add your company details for the Hontrio invoice
email_profile_body: The fee for {{store}} in {{month}} is {{amount}}, but the invoice can't be issued without your company details. Add them in Settings, under Billing, and we'll issue it right away.
admin_start_off: Off. Hontrio is free, during the launch period.
admin_start_confirm_desc: The notice goes out now, by email and in the app, to every client. Sales before this date are not counted.
admin_started: The start is scheduled and the notice has gone out.
admin_err_start: The start date must be {{date}} or later, 30 days after the notice.
admin_smartbill_on: Connected. Invoices are issued in the configured series.
admin_smartbill_off: Not connected. SMARTBILL_USERNAME, SMARTBILL_TOKEN, SMARTBILL_CIF or SMARTBILL_SERIES is missing in Vercel.
admin_smartbill_series: The invoice series exists in the account
admin_suspended_title: Stores with the autopilot paused for non-payment
admin_resolve_desc: SmartBill didn't answer when issuing. Look for the invoice in SmartBill. If it exists, enter its series and number; if not, it can be issued again.
admin_voided: The invoice is marked as cancelled.
admin_exclude_desc: A statement not yet invoiced is recalculated. If the invoice was already issued, the difference becomes a credit on the next invoice.
admin_excluded: The order is removed from the calculation.
